u0: Initial blocker-pending state: the ball has not been cleared from the cell in front of the locked door, so the RM has made no progress and the door cannot be opened yet. Move to that cell and pick up the ball to make blocker_moved true and advance to u1. If the key was picked up first, it must be dropped before the ball can be moved; holding the key alone does not leave u0.
u1: Blocker-cleared stage: the RM records that the ball has been moved away from the door front, but the agent is not simultaneously holding the matching door key. Next, acquire the key whose color matches the door while keeping the door-front cell free of the ball; advancing to u2 requires blocker_moved and has_door_key together. If the ball is dropped back in front of the door, clear it again; if the key is dropped before the door opens, key_lost can fire and no RM progress is made.
u2: Door-opening stage: the RM has recorded both blocker_moved and a matching-key acquisition, but the door is still closed. Next, go to the door and toggle it with the matching key to make door_open true and advance to u3. If the key is no longer held, pick it up again first: dropping it before opening can fire key_lost, but the RM remains in u2 because only door_open advances.
u3: Door-open, target-pending stage: the door has been opened, but the mission's designated box has not yet been picked up. Next, enter the other room, drop the key if it is still occupying the hand, locate the box named in the mission, and pick it up to reach terminal u4. If the door has been toggled shut, reopen it first; the RM remains in u3 until target_picked_up.
u4: Terminal success state: the agent is carrying the mission-designated box, so target_picked_up is true and the episode ends immediately. The task is complete, no further objective remains, and this final RM state self-loops if any further transition were considered.
